74:48.text: So no intercession of intercessors will be of any use to them.

74:49.text: Then what is wrong with them

74:51.text: Fleeing from a hunter, or a lion, or a beast of prey.

74:52.text: Nay, everyone of them desires that he should be given pages spread out
(coming from Allâh with a writing that Islâm is the right religion, and Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم has come with the truth from Allâh, the Lord of the heavens and earth)

74:53.text: Nay! But they fear not the Hereafter

74:56.text: And they will not receive admonition unless Allâh wills; He
is the One, deserving that mankind should be afraid of, and should be dutiful to Him, and should not take any Ilâh
along with Him, and He is the One Who forgives

75:1.text: I swear by the Day of Resurrection.

75:2.text: And I swear by the self-reproaching person

75:3.text: think that We shall not assemble his bones?

75:4.text: Yes, We are Able to put together in perfect order the tips of his fingers.

75:6.text: He asks: "When will be this Day of Resurrection?"

75:7.text: So, when the sight shall be dazed.

75:8.text: And the moon will be eclipsed.

75:9.text: And the sun and moon will be joined together
(by going one into the other or folded up or deprived of their light)

75:10.text: On that Day man will say: "Where

75:12.text: will be the place of rest that Day.

75:13.text: On that Day man will be informed of what he sent forward

75:14.text: Nay! Man will be a witness against himself
[as his body parts (skin, hands, legs, etc.) will speak about his deeds]

75:15.text: Though he may put forth his excuses

75:16.text: (the Qur’ân, O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم)

75:17.text: It is for Us to collect it and to give you

75:18.text: And when We have recited it to you
[O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم through Jibrîl (Gabriel)]
